newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nutreco buys Spanish poultry firm Herca.
newsitem.headline: Nutreco buys Spanish poultry firm Herca.

text.p: Dutch animal and fish feeds group Nutreco Holding NV said on Thursday it had bought the remaining 56 percent of Spanish poultry processor Herca SA.
Herca has 122 employees and produces poultry meat. It posted 1996 sales of about 38 million guilders.
The remaining stake was bought from Herca's founders Justo Carrasco and Felipe Hernandez, Nutreco said without elaborating.
The Dutch group said Herca's activities and regional presence in central Spain fitted very well with those of Nutreco's Spanish subsidiary Sada, which operates five slaughter houses for broilers.
Sada, which has 644 employees, posted 1996 turnover of about 400 million guilders, Nutreco said.
